observation: The Python 3.12 subprocess documentation states that text mode uses the specified encoding and errors, or the default encoding of an io.TextIOWrapper when they are omitted; an explicit encoding is therefore a valid way to make the text contract deterministic.
scope: Python 3.12 subprocess.run and Popen text-mode stream decoding.
title: subprocess — Subprocess management — Python 3.12.13 documentation
worker_claim_observations: The subprocess documentation states that text=true or encoding/errors specified opens standard streams in text mode using the specified encoding/errors or io.TextIOWrapper defaults; it also states that streams are binary without text mode.
